subject: learning/parallel-memory-gitsrc
statement: Pinned memory and policy Git reads reject unavailable listed blobs and prohibit lazy fetching; policy discovery preserves exact Git paths, node types, and modes.
intent: Keep memory verification deterministic and offline, including partial clones and large partitioned policies.
rationale: An unavailable listed blob must not silently disappear from the inventory or trigger network access. NUL-delimited tree and index reads preserve exact names, while one tree listing and one batch read avoid a Git subprocess per allowance.
